regions.region: page 1 title, author block, abstract, graphical abstract, keywords, DOI, and article summary
regions.finding: Verified the article title and aggregate 37–61% yield/90–99% ee method claim. The graphical abstract is a summary and does not define an extra experiment. No SI association was inferred.
The diphenylprolinol CuBr2 allenylation is explicitly labeled previous work and represented as a literature example, not a current-paper experiment.
The dimethylprolinol reaction with terminal alkynols is the generic current transformation and is classified as a general scheme; table rows carry experiment-specific outcomes.
Narrative comparison of alkynols 1a–f and both chiral amines maps to the eighteen Table 1 condition records on page 2; no duplicate narrative experiments were created.

unresolved: The generic arrows contain R/FG/n variables and do not define unique structures or complete conditions.
The article mentions online Supporting Information later, but workspace source mapping leaves SI association unestablished.

regions.region: page 2 upper Table 1 reaction header, entries 1–9, and footnotes
regions.finding: Each of the two chiral-amine columns was retained as a separate condition, giving eighteen records with exact shared scale, CuBr2 loading, solvent, nitrogen atmosphere, 130 °C/12 h, isolated yield, and ee. Entry 1/(S)-3a is flagged as cited Ref. 9a data rather than a current run.

regions.region: page 2 lower Table 2 reaction header, entries 1–6, and footnotes
regions.finding: Six limiting-reagent optimization conditions were reconciled. Entry 1 is the same 1.5:1.5:1 (S)-3b experiment as Table 1 entry 3 and is merged; entries 2–6 remain separate. Ratios are preserved verbatim; only entry 6 has explicit narrative equivalents.
The comparison of yield/ee and selection of the 1:1.4:1.2 limiting-reagent condition is linked to the corresponding table records, not duplicated as extra experiments.

unresolved: Table 2's '1 mmol scale' does not explicitly map a denominator/component to every relative-ratio row.
Most table-only rows omit workup, purification, isolated mass, and ee measurement basis.

regions.region: page 3 upper narrative and Table 3 entries 1–5 with footnotes
regions.finding: Nine distinct aromatic-aldehyde reactions were retained: paired (S)-3a/(S)-3b conditions for entries 1, 2, 3, and 5, plus the changed-ratio (S)-3b-only entry 4. Dashes under entry 4/(S)-3a were not converted to a zero-yield run.
A distinct 10 mmol 1d scale-up gives (R)-4da, 1.4561 g, 55%, 97% ee; it remains separate from the 1.5 mmol Table 1 condition and is linked to its detailed page-6 paragraph.
Two separate low-yield reactions were retained for (S)-3a and (S)-3b, giving 6% and 12% NMR yields of (R)-4ci under otherwise shared displayed conditions.
The aerobic oxidation and Mitsunobu reactions are introduced here and linked to Scheme 4A/B on page 4 rather than duplicated.

unresolved: Table 3 rows omit workup, purification, product mass, and ee analytical basis on pages 1–6.
Scheme 3 does not state chiral-amine amount, solvent volume, NMR internal standard, or ee.

regions.finding: The iodination, malonate alkylation, and hydrolysis/acidification/thermal decarboxylation stages are separate arrow-level records. The 61% value remains a two-step yield from (R)-4da to (R)-8, while 78% applies to the displayed (R)-8-to-(R)-9 sequence.
The Fe(NO3)3·9H2O/TEMPO/NaCl/O2 oxidation of (R)-4ca at room temperature for 4.5 h gives (R)-5 in 60% with 95% ee; all three 20 mol% components are participants.

The 0 °C-to-room-temperature program is represented as low-temperature addition, an untimed warming transition, and a room-temperature 12 h stage; phthalimide, PPh3, and DEAD each carry the displayed 2 equiv where applicable.

Three arrow-level records preserve the 5 °C/20 min iodination, room-temperature malonate alkylation with missing time, and the ordered 100 °C/2.5 h hydrolysis, untimed HCl acidification, and 120 °C/29 h AcOH stage.

regions.region: page 4 mechanism prose and beginning of Typical Procedure I
regions.finding: Mechanistic prose maps to Scheme 5 on page 5. The first half of the (R)-4aa Typical Procedure supplies exact CuBr2/(S)-3b/1a/2a charges and separate 1.5 mL carrier portions; it enriches Table 1 entry 1/(S)-3b.

unresolved: Scheme 4B addition/ramp times are not printed.
The iodination stage has no stage-specific yield; the alkylation time is missing.
Scheme 4C acidification temperature/time and most exact charges/volumes are not reported on pages 1–6.

regions.finding: IN-1, iminium 11, (S,S)-12, IN-2, and IN-3 are proposed mechanistic intermediates. They are represented in one mechanism record, not as isolated preparations.

regions.region: page 5 left column continuation of Typical Procedure I for (R)-4aa
regions.finding: Completes the exact nitrogen/130 °C/12 h operation, Et2O/HCl/extraction/brine/Na2SO4 workup, chromatography, 0.1372 g/61% product, and HPLC 96% ee for the existing Table 1 entry 1/(S)-3b record.
Enriches Table 1 entry 2/(S)-3a with exact charges, two chromatographies, 0.1161 g/49%, and HPLC 86% ee.
Enriches Table 1 entry 2/(S)-3b with exact charges, chromatography, 0.1227 g/51%, and HPLC 95% ee.
The detailed 1c/2a/(S)-3a experiment begins here and continues on page 6; it enriches one existing Table 1 condition rather than creating a duplicate.

unresolved: The proposed mechanism does not establish observation or quantities for intermediates.

regions.region: page 6 upper-left completion of (R)-4ca using (S)-3a and detailed (S)-3b run
regions.finding: Completes the (S)-3a record with second chromatography and 0.1405 g/56%/85% ee, and separately enriches the (S)-3b record with 0.1345 g/53%/95% ee. The latter is also the merged Table 2 entry 1 condition.

regions.region: page 6 left column detailed (R)-4da using (S)-3a and (S)-3b
regions.finding: Two separate Table 1 entry-4 conditions were enriched with exact charges, purifications, masses, isolated yields, and HPLC ee values: 0.1363 g/51%/88% and 0.1508 g/57%/93%.
The Scheme 2 scale-up was completed with exact reagent purities/charges, two 15 mL 1,4-dioxane carrier portions, nitrogen operation, workup volumes, 1000 mL chromatography, 1.4561 g/55%, and 97% ee.

regions.region: page 6 lower-right detailed (R)-4ea using both chiral amines
regions.finding: Two distinct Table 1 entry-5 conditions were enriched with exact charges, two-stage purifications, 0.1303 g/46%/87% ee and 0.1447 g/52%/96% ee. The original image resolves an extracted-text column interleaving near the (S)-3a paragraph.
